roads.name: Henry Hudson Drive
words: Properly twisty: 15 curves in 3.0 miles, about 5 a mile.
From 7 to 156 ft, with 526 ft of up and down along the way.
Water alongside for stretches.
8 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
July highs average 86°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 1.00 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.

roads.name: Bronx River Parkway
words: Sweeping and steady: 38 curves in 10.4 miles.
From 79 to 232 ft, with 653 ft of up and down along the way.

Built up in places.
29 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
July highs average 85°F.
